finding: Positive diagonal compression keeps projected corners inside a fixed box. Sampled X compression about3.9%, Y/Z12.7%. Review did not establish a followability improvement, so no new app or refinement was made.
limitations: Authored display mapping, no pressure/inertia/volume physics. Offscreen sampled images and GIF cadence do not prove continuous desktop playback or perception benefit.
